assets.initialPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium 2D hand-painted game VFX animation SPRITE SHEET on real transparent alpha. Create exactly TWELVE consecutive frames of ONE small fiery ground detonation for a polished cartoon top-down action game. Precise 4 columns by 3 rows uniform grid, square canvas; frame order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. All cells have IDENTICAL camera, anchor and scale; baseline at 75% height of EACH cell, horizontally centered. Frames 1-2: compact white-yellow ignition. Frames 3-5: organic yellow-orange billowing fireball expands upward with irregular sharp licking flames and curled orange lobes. Frames 6-8: fire curls outward and red-orange smoke takes over as the bright center diminishes. Frames 9-12: broken dark warm smoke wisps dissolve and vanish, last frame almost empty. This is a single continuous blast, not a looping flame or separate unrelated icons. Style: highly polished painterly game VFX, fiery golden edges, deep warm amber-red interior shadows, detailed turbulent shapes. Subtle top-down/isometric angle, explosive radial width and a short rising plume. NO floor, NO ground shadows, NO rings or shockwaves, NO sparks outside cell; those will be animated separately. At maximum expansion each frame fills only 75% of its own cell, generous transparent gutters on all sides. All shapes fully inside each cell. No grid lines, numbers, text, icons or backdrop. Every empty space must be true alpha=0, never semiopaque white or checkerboard. Keep flame whites opaque, soft transparent edges, no crop anywhere.
